15.name: Grand Premiere: Darr Ka Naya Daur!
15.overview: Rohit Shetty is back with a brand-new era of fear, where every stunt is bigger, tougher, and more unpredictable than ever.

15.name: Fear Gets Personal
15.overview: The contestants come face-to-face with their deepest personal fears, where every challenge pushes them beyond their comfort zone and tests their courage like never before!

15.name: Fear of Privacy, Unlocked!
15.overview: A new level of Khatra unravels as the contestants face not just dangerous stunts but an unexpected challenge-the fear of losing their privacy.

15.name: No Privacy, No Mercy
15.overview: With no privacy left, the return of the Pain Auction forces contestants to make ruthless choices, proving that fear shows no mercy.

15.name: Fear of Change
15.overview: The fear of change gets bigger as contestants face situations where nothing stays the same. With every twist, they’ll have to adapt, and overcome a whole new kind of fear!

15.name: Sab Hoga Achanak-Bhayanak!
15.overview: When there’s no warning and no time to prepare, anything can happen. This time, the unexpected gets even more terrifying as contestants face fears that come achanak…aur bhayanak!

15.name: Har Second Mein Darr
15.overview: Time becomes the biggest challenge for the contestants, as today every second counts! With pressure building, they must keep their nerve and ace it before time runs out.

15.name: Racing against the 'Khatra'
15.overview: Time is no longer just a challenge—it becomes the biggest fear. With every passing second pushing contestants closer to their limit, will they be able to beat the clock?

15.name: It's a High-Stakes Blockbuster
15.overview: Between Bollywood-style drama and full-on action, contestants are all set to face blockbuster challenges. But as the pressure rises, so will the stakes!

15.name: Lights, Camera, Khatra!
15.overview: Drama, action, and danger continue in this Bollywood special blockbuster! Who'll rise as the champion?

15.name: All Eyes on 'Special Power'
15.overview: One Khiladi gets a chance to make a comeback, while others enter the race for special power. With the stakes higher than ever, the fight gets grittier!

15.name: Face-off! Crack it for the Jacket
15.overview: The race reaches its final showdown as the contestants battle it out for an epic win. Who will rise above the rest and claim the jacket?

15.name: Khatra Trending Hai
15.overview: Brace for a high-thrilling experience as the Khiladis take on epic challenges while Rohit gets their trending report. The trends get bigger, and so does the Khatra!

15.name: Game Mein Aayega Twist!
15.overview: An unexpected turn changes the game for the Khiladis. With tougher stunts and rising danger, they’ll have to be ready for anything!

15.name: Revenge Mode On
15.overview: The Khiladis get their chance to settle scores as Revenge Week kicks off! With tougher stunts and unexpected challenges, the intense game begins.

15.name: The 'Badla' Gets Bigger
15.overview: The revenge game goes to the next level as the Khiladis face tougher stunts and bigger challenges. With Badla on their mind, the Khatra gets even fiercer than before!

15.name: Race to the Semi-finale
15.overview: Eyeing a place in the semi-finale, the Khiladis go head to head in adrenaline-filled stunts. Who’ll ace this race?

15.name: An Epic Showdown!
15.overview: The stakes get higher as the remaining Khiladis fight to secure their place in the finale. Every stunt counts as the competition reaches its most crucial stage.

15.name: Final Padhav: It’s Now or Never!
15.overview: The finale race begins as Khiladis battle through gritty challenges. Here, every minute and every action matters, as they fight neck to neck for the coveted trophy.

overview: Twelve celebrity contestants face their worst fears and perform a series of death-defying stunts under the supervision of a host to win the coveted title.

seasons.name: Season 7: Kabhi Peeda Kabhi Keeda in Argentina
Season 9: Jigar Pe Trigger
seasons.overview: Khatron Ke Khiladi which is one of the much-loved adventure reality shows is now in its ninth season. As per reports, the show will air in 2019. The show's 9th installment which has been titled as Khatron Ke Khiladi - Jigar Pe Trigger has been pushed to next year. And the same means that the show will air post Bigg Boss Season 12. As per India-Forums report, the show will start airing from 19th January 2019. Fans of the show can save the date. The wait is quite long but the same is worth the wait as the ninth season will be super exciting considering contestants like Zain Imam, Vikas Gupta, Bharti Singh and Aly Goni among others. The show’s shoot got recently wrapped up in Argentina and according to reports, the top three contestants were Ridhima Pandit, Punit J Pathak and Aditya Narayan.

seasons.name: Khatron Ke Khiladi 15
seasons.overview: Host Rohit Shetty returns with a terrifying new edition of India's ultimate stunt-based reality show. Filmed in Cape Town, South Africa, Season 15 introduces the theme "Darr Ka Naya Daur," pit-fighting returning fan favorites against first-time celebrity contestants. Pushed beyond their mental and physical limits, these daredevils must conquer harrowing heights, freezing waters, and deadly predators to survive the ultimate test of fear.
